Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Lieutenant Watts]]: the producer Robert Watts, holding a production binder, on location in the California desert during the making of ''Return of the Jedi'', with Jabba's sail barge set and the film crew behind him. Cropped and reduced to 640 pixels wide.

Source: [https://www.lucasfilm.com/news/robert-watts-1938-2024/ Remembering Robert Watts, 1938-2024], Lucasfilm, captioned "Watts on location in the California desert during production of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260416175822/https://www.lucasfilm.com/news/robert-watts-1938-2024/ Internet Archive], 16 April 2026; image file preserved at [https://web.archive.org/web/20251201083228/https://www.lucasfilm.com/app/uploads/robert-watts-sail-barge-jedi-gallery.jpg Internet Archive], 1 December 2025.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a reduced crop (640 by 576 pixels) of a Lucasfilm photo of Robert Watts at work as a producer, the person the card's name refers to. It is used only to identify him beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free photo of him at work exists.
